description: This file defines the PermissionManager singleton that manages various application permissions on macOS, including location, notifications, camera, microphone, speech recognition, screen recording, and AppleScript. It also provides helper classes to open system settings and request specific permissions asynchronously, along with a permission monitor for periodic status checks.

classes.name: LocationPermissionRequester
classes.description: Handles requesting and monitoring location permission status using CLLocationManager, including interactive prompts and timeout handling.

classes.name: PermissionMonitor
classes.description: Singleton class that monitors and periodically updates the permission status for various capabilities, with registration and deregistration.

methods.name: isLocationAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if a given CLLocationAuthorizationStatus is considered authorized, optionally requiring 'always' permission.

methods.name: ensure
methods.description: Ensures that a list of capabilities are granted, optionally interactively prompting the user.

methods.name: ensureCapability
methods.description: Checks and requests authorization for a specific capability interactively if needed.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns the current authorization status for all capabilities.

methods.name: openSettings
methods.description: Opens the system preferences pane for a specific permission (notifications, microphone, camera, location).

methods.name: request
methods.description: Asynchronously requests location permission, potentially prompting the user.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Verifies if AppleScript automation permission is granted by executing a benign AppleScript.

methods.name: requestAuthorization
methods.description: Triggers the system prompt for AppleScript automation permission and opens system preferences if needed.

methods.name: refreshNow
methods.description: For PermissionMonitor: triggers immediate permission status re-check.
